title: tack.yaml
description: Config for tack, a Go dependency-wiring generator. See https://github.com/benipranata/tack.

providers.description: Package directories (relative to the go.mod that owns this config) scanned for the global provider scope, shared by every configured output variant unless shadowed by a local provider of the same type.

items.description: One interface, declared in package, and one or more named output variants to generate for it.

package.description: Module-relative directory where the interface is declared.

interface.description: Go interface name declared in package.

output.description: One or more named implementations to generate for this interface.

name.description: Constructor/struct name prefix, e.g. name: App -> NewAppIface.

package.description: Module-relative directory to write the generated file into and scan as this variant's local provider scope. Defaults to the target's package. Created automatically if it doesn't yet exist.

file.description: Generated file name. Defaults to lower(name)_lower(interface)_gen.go.

localScan.description: Set to false to resolve this variant only from the global provider scope, skipping its own effective directory as a local scope.
